past_experiences.problem_summary: 我想制造一款精密成型轮模 材质Cr12MoV 外径53mm 轴孔14mm 宽度45mm 三道圆弧槽R15 R12 R10
past_experiences.solution_strategy: 协同 Agent Team：架构拆解 -> 参数化特征树 -> GD&T 标注 -> G71 宏程序 -> 沙箱闭环自愈
key_rules_learned: 回转特征必须优先绑定 swEqnMgr 方程式管理器
精密切削必须使用 G71 粗车留 0.4mm 余量再经 G70 精修
沙箱仿真必须验证 ForceRebuild3 与 G00 快速移动无负向切削碰撞
past_experiences.code_snippet:
' SolidWorks 2021 Automated Inverse-Deduction Macro
' Generated by Virtu Autonomous Engineering Agent
Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim swModel As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swPart As SldWorks.PartDoc
Dim swFeatMgr As SldWorks.FeatureManager
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set swModel = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    Set swPart = swModel
    Set swFeatMgr = swModel.FeatureManager
    Set swEqnMgr = swModel.GetEquationMgr

    ' 1. Bind Deduced Parametric Equations
    swEqnMgr.Add -1, """"D_Outer"" = 53.0"
    swEqnMgr.Add -1, """"D_Inner"" = 14.0"
    swEqnMgr.Add -1, """"Total_Length"" = 45.0"
    swEqnMgr.EvaluateAll

    ' 2. Create Base Sketch & Solid Geometry
    swModel.Extension.SelectByID2 "Top Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    swModel.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    swModel.SketchManager.CreateCenterRec
